name: io.github.kant19801201behax5/phoenix-mcp-server
title: Phoenix Zero — L2 Health Oracle
description: Pre-flight L2 health check using kernel-level eBPF telemetry. PASS/DEGRADED/FAIL verdict.

tools.name: check_safety_free
tools.description: FREE safety check for L2 networks (100 calls/IP/day). Returns safe/unsafe verdict with reason code for any of 12 chains. No payment required.

tools.name: preflight_network_health
tools.description: Determine whether an L2 network is suitable for transaction execution using kernel-level eBPF telemetry. Returns PASS/DEGRADED/FAIL with RTT, revert ratio, and timestamp evidence. Covers 12 L2 chains. health_check metric is free; rtt_ns and revert_ratio require x402 $0.01.
